nodes.label: Query Graph Before Grep/Read Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify update . After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current via AST-only extraction with no API cost; large graph.json diffs in PRs are expected and should not be flagged.

nodes.label: 'MySQL connected; persistent database ready.' startup log
nodes.norm_label: 'mysql connected; persistent database ready.' startup log

nodes.label: MySQL Migration Procedure
nodes.rationale: Recovery import preserves existing rows on duplicate Discord/Riot IDs; import newer host SQLite export first, then recovery export to fill gaps. Do not re-import recovery SQL each deployment.

nodes.label: MySQL-Only Persistence (SQLite Removed)
nodes.rationale: All player links, leaderboard stats and voice room states persist in MySQL; SQLite was fully removed.

nodes.label: Rank Role Matching (League vs Valorant)
nodes.rationale: League uses configured role IDs; Valorant role names must contain 'Valorant' or 'VAL' so separate per-game roles prevent a Valorant refresh from removing League ranks; unchanged roles are left alone.

nodes.label: No SQLite Fallback (MySQL config required for login)
nodes.norm_label: no sqlite fallback (mysql config required for login)
nodes.rationale: Missing or invalid MySQL configuration prevents Discord login; MySQL persists data but does not keep the hosting process alive.
